cause_quote: The new github-publication-task-workspace.ts keyed each linked publication task by the tool call: `const taskId = deriveGitHubPublicationTaskId(origin, params.idempotencyKey);`, so every fresh github_publish(workspacePath) call created a new task, branch and PR.
user_saw: Publishing a local checkout again after a follow-up commit (for example a CI fix) opened a second pull request instead of updating the first.
summary: Keys local publication tasks by conversation and canonical checkout (reusing older invocation-keyed tasks when exactly one matches) and merges the checkout's newest commit into the task branch so later publications update the same PR.
reasoning: Before #196168, the local workspacePath flow from #184531 adopted the checkout into the conversation, so later publications from that session went to the session's one PR; #196168 replaced that adoption with linked tasks keyed by the invocation idempotency key, which the fix PR names as the cause. Medium because I read the causing line and the replaced adoption design but did not trace the pre-#196168 republish path end to end.
